title: Tier0 — A100 kernel baseline (throughput envelope, per-gen, parity, scale)

question.zh: 在真实目标硬件(8x A100-80GB)上重新确立 kernel 的核心数据:3 个 variant 各自的 throughput vs batch size、EvoGP 每代 wallclock(CO-fraction 的分母)、fp32-vs-fp64 parity,以及 magnitude-scan 质量门禁。全程 fp32。
question.en: Re-establish the kernel's core numbers on the real target hardware (8x A100-80GB): throughput vs batch size for all 3 variants, EvoGP per-gen wallclock (the CO-fraction denominator), fp32-vs-fp64 parity, and the magnitude-scan quality gate. fp32 throughout.

setup.zh: 每次计时只用单卡 A100,手动 pin(CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES),从 GPU2-7 池中选取(把 0、1 留给机器主人的作业)。throughput 在单个合成 preset(early-gen)上扫描、只变 M,因此每棵树的代价固定,曲线单独反映 GPU 利用率随规模的变化。N=7 次计时重复 + 丢弃 2 次 warmup;device wall-time 从二进制输出解析。时钟未锁(无 sudo),但在持续负载下会 boost 到 1410 MHz 的 SM 上限。
setup.en: Single A100 per timed run, manually pinned (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES), pool GPU2-7 (left 0,1 for the box owner's jobs). Throughput swept on one synthetic preset (early-gen) varying M, so per-tree cost is fixed and the curve isolates GPU-utilization scaling. N=7 timed repeats + 2 warmup discarded; device wall-time parsed from the binary. Clocks unlocked (no sudo) but boost to the 1410 MHz SM ceiling under sustained load.

env.clock_policy: UNLOCKED (no sudo); SM auto-boosts to 1410 MHz under load, sampled per-run
env.exclusivity: manual pin + pre-check; pool GPU2-7 verified free at launch

sweep.variants: batch_lm (baseline, host-FD), batch_lm_devjac (device Jacobian), batch_lm_fusedfd (fused FD)
sweep.M_list: 1000, 4000, 16000, 64000 (+256000 for devjac/fusedfd; baseline stops at 64k: host-FD too slow + saturated)
sweep.metric: trees/s = M / device_wall_time; report median + p10/p90
sweep.reference_point: real data/fixtures/pop.bin (1000 real EvoGP trees) kept for cross-machine (laptop) comparison

kernel.precision: fp32 (design target: EvoGP + pop.bin data are fp32; no fp64 signal to recover)
kernel.timing_source: clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) around the full solve (device wall, host orchestration included)

synth_gen.early-gen_marginals: mirrors real snapshot I.18.12_pop4000 gen5: nodes_mean 12.4, K_mean 2.77, trig 0.30 (calibrated to within +/-5%)
synth_gen.tree_structure: size ~ lognormal(2.40,0.54) clipped 3-32 nodes; ops weighted by real opcode frequencies; leaves var/const by p_const
synth_gen.c_init: c_true * U(0.7,1.3) + N(0,0.02)  (constants perturbed ~+/-30%, mimics 'not yet tuned')
synth_gen.x_points: U(0.5,2.5), shared across the whole population
synth_gen.rejection: resample trees whose y is non-finite or |y| > 1e6 (DIV poles, tan asymptotes)
synth_gen.problem_type: RECOVERABLE (CO can reach near c_true) -> performance + precision axis (NOT the quality-tier story)

claim.zh: 1000 棵树严重未充分利用 A100

evidence.zh: baseline @ M=1000 = 787 t/s,低于笔记本 5070Ti 的 1319 t/s。在这个 batch 下大 GPU 是 latency/overhead-bound -> 在 A100 上固定 1000 棵树的 throughput 毫无意义;必须扫描 M。
evidence.en: baseline @ M=1000 = 787 t/s, BELOW the laptop 5070Ti's 1319 t/s. The big GPU is latency/overhead-bound at this batch -> a fixed 1000-tree throughput is meaningless on A100; you must sweep M.

claim.zh: 在 A100 上 variant 间的差距随规模 WIDENS(与 laptop-PCIe 假设相反)
claim.en: The variant gap WIDENS at scale on A100 (opposite of the laptop-PCIe hypothesis)

evidence.zh: 在 M=64k 时 fusedfd 36551 vs baseline 1277 t/s(约 29x);fusedfd 在 256k 达到 50394 且仍在上升。baseline 的 host-FD 每个 FD 步都做 H<->D round-trip -> 这是一个不随 GPU 扩展的串行瓶颈,而 devjac/fusedfd 全程留在 device 上。RERUN_A100.md 曾预测差距在 A100 上会 NARROW;实际却扩大了。
evidence.en: At M=64k fusedfd 36551 vs baseline 1277 t/s (~29x); fusedfd reaches 50394 @256k still climbing. baseline's host-FD does H<->D round-trips every FD step -> a serial bottleneck that does NOT scale with the GPU, while devjac/fusedfd stay on-device. RERUN_A100.md predicted the gap would NARROW on A100; it widens.

claim.zh: fusedfd 即使到 256k 也未饱和;devjac 在约 24k 处平台;baseline 平在约 1.3-1.5k
claim.en: fusedfd has not saturated even at 256k; devjac plateaus ~24k; baseline flat ~1.3-1.5k

claim.zh: CO 仍是整个 GP 循环的绝对瓶颈
claim.en: CO remains the absolute bottleneck of the GP loop

evidence.zh: EvoGP 每代演化均值 = 5.2ms(pop1000)/ 5.3ms(pop4000),而一次全种群 CO pass 是数百 ms -> 循环内时间由 CO 主导。
evidence.en: EvoGP per-gen evolution = 5.2ms (pop1000) / 5.3ms (pop4000) mean, while one full-population CO pass is hundreds of ms -> in-loop time is dominated by CO.

claim.zh: A100 上的 fp32 质量与笔记本一致,无变化
claim.en: fp32 quality is unchanged on A100 vs laptop

evidence.zh: parity gate 3/3 PASS,数值为 94.0 / 92.4 / 99.8(loss-down / within-1.05x / within-10x),与笔记本 baseline 完全一致;magnitude scan tier1 11/11 + tier2 5/5 对 3 个 variant 全部 PASS。
evidence.en: parity gate 3/3 PASS at 94.0 / 92.4 / 99.8 (loss-down / within-1.05x / within-10x), identical to the laptop baseline; magnitude scan tier1 11/11 + tier2 5/5 PASS for all 3 variants.

claim.zh: 未锁的时钟在计时中是稳定的
claim.en: Unlocked clocks are stable for timing

evidence.zh: 在所有持续负载的计时运行中,SM clock 采样均为 1410 MHz(A100 上限);无需 sudo 即可锁定。
evidence.en: SM clock sampled at 1410 MHz (the A100 ceiling) across all sustained-load timed runs; no sudo needed to lock.

tables.name: Parity gate (A100, fp32 vs scipy fp64)

caption.zh: CO throughput vs batch size M(log-log,fp32,N=7 中位数 +/- range)。x 标记 = 笔记本 5070Ti @ M=1000 参考点。大 M 的点(64k-256k)是 saturation/envelope 探测,并非对真实 workload 的断言。
caption.en: CO throughput vs batch size M (log-log, fp32, N=7 median +/- range). x markers = laptop 5070Ti @ M=1000 reference. Wide-M points (64k-256k) are saturation/envelope probes, not a realistic-workload claim.

caveats.zh: Synth = 可恢复问题(性能 + 精度轴)。真实 GP snapshot(质量-tier 的故事)是单独的一次运行,不包含在此。
caveats.en: Synth = recoverable problem (performance + precision axis). Real GP snapshots (the quality-tier story) are a separate run, not included here.

caveats.zh: 第一次 sweep 已 DISCARDED:未被 kill 的重复(修复前)进程与 GPU2-4 共租,污染了计时并与输出文件产生竞争。这里的数字来自干净的单进程 rerun(tp2_*)。
caveats.en: The first sweep was DISCARDED: un-killed duplicate (pre-fix) processes co-tenanted GPU2-4 and contaminated timing + raced the output files. Numbers here are the clean single-process rerun (tp2_*).

caveats.zh: baseline @ 256k 跳过:host-FD 约 160s/run x 9 太浪费,而且它在 4k 时就已饱和。
caveats.en: baseline @ 256k skipped: host-FD ~160s/run x 9 is wasteful and it is already saturated by 4k.

caveats.zh: M 到 256k 是 saturation/envelope 探测;'真实工作点' 要与 kernel 性能协同设计、稍后再定(不绑定到当前的 pop=4000)。
caveats.en: M up to 256k is a saturation/envelope probe; the 'realistic operating point' is co-designed with kernel performance and decided later (not pinned to today's pop=4000).

caveats.zh: 时钟未锁(无 sudo);在负载下会 boost 到 1410 MHz 并按每次运行记录,但未做硬 pin。
caveats.en: Clocks unlocked (no sudo); they boost to 1410 MHz under load and are recorded per run, but not hard-pinned.

reproduce: cd cusr/kernel && nvcc -O2 -arch=sm_80 -std=c++17 -lineinfo --use_fast_math -o batch_lm_devjac batch_lm_devjac.cu loader.c && cd ../..
# throughput sweep (one variant per pinned GPU): python sweep.py --bin <bin> --gpu <id> --label <v> --out <f> --mlist 1000,4000,16000,64000,256000
# parity: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<g> GATE_REPORT=docs/kernel/verify_report_a100.md uv run python cusr/kernel/tests/test_parity_gate.py
# scale: BATCH_LM=cusr/kernel/batch_lm_<v> uv run python cusr/kernel/tests/test_fixture_scale.py
